info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Pharmacy Prescriptions Interactions-v5-spec
info.description: The Pharmacy Prescription Interactions API provides a comprehensive overview of potential interactions within pharmacy prescriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed information regarding various prescription interactions to ensure safe medication practices. It primarily serves healthcare professionals and pharmacists who need to assess prescription compatibility and enhance patient safety. Use cases may include checking for drug-drug interactions, managing patient allergies, and improving medication management during consultations.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch potential interactions between prescribed medications. It helps healthcare providers and patients to better understand the risks associated with concurrent medication usage.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch prescription interaction information. It must conform to the specified JSON schema that outlines the required structure and properties for the request.
